international_perspectives.text: A regional monitoring mission said it was unable to access the area to verify either account.

reported_claims.text: Kestria's defence ministry says four soldiers were killed by Valdoran shelling.
Valdor's government says Kestrian forces fired first and that two civilians were injured.

title: DEMO: Cross-border artillery exchanges along disputed valley
summary: DEMONSTRATION RECORD. The fictional states of Kestria and Valdor each report artillery fire from the other side of a disputed valley. Casualty figures differ sharply between the two governments and have not been independently verified.
impact_assessment: Observed: displacement of an estimated 3,000 residents (humanitarian agency figure). Potential: wider escalation if regular forces are reinforced; disruption to the valley's hydroelectric plant.
priority_rationale: High: credible reports of armed exchanges between state forces with displacement, but casualty claims are contested and no independent verification is available.
monitoring_actions: Track displacement figures from humanitarian agencies

update_history.summary: Trend changed from Stable to Escalating after second day of exchanges.
